# Hair Jordan Salon

> Hair salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. A friendly little salon in Jordan Square, a stone's throw from IU. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, perms and vivid shades, with stylists who take their time and actually talk with you.

- Phone: (812) 339-1818
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.5 from 232 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/hair-jordan-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/hair-jordan-salon/book.html

## Services
- Women's cuts: Bobs, shaggy bangs, layers and clean-up trims. Tell your stylist what you have in mind and they will take the time to get it right.
- Men's cuts: Quick, sharp cuts and fades with good conversation in the chair. Reviewers call Sharma's cuts some of the best in Bloomington.
- Color & highlights: Warm copper, rich auburn and blended highlights that grow out softly.
- Vivid color: Hot pink, orange tips and anything bright. The color work is half the fun here.
- Grow-outs & perms: Growing your hair out and stuck in the awkward phase? A shaping trim keeps it looking good on the way. Perms are on the menu too.
- Blowouts & updos: A shampoo and blowout or a shampoo and updo for a night out, photos or just because.

## About
Hair Jordan Salon is in Suite C of Jordan Square at 1400 E 3rd St, a stone's throw from the IU campus. Look for the teal sign with the gold scissors over the red brick, the pink neon in the window and the bench out front with the flower pots. Sharma owns the salon and has run it for more than two decades; his "SHARMA The MAN" plate sits on the front counter, under the Audrey Hepburn prints. Julie does women's cuts and color (and brings in homemade cookies and muffins for clients), and clients have been coming back to her for years. Hannah is the one people mention for trims that make a grow-out look good. Students, locals, kids and grown-ups all sit in the same chairs. Walk-ins are welcome, but appointments are appreciated: book online any time or call the salon. There is free parking right in front for Jordan Square customers, plus bike parking, free Wi-Fi, and cards are accepted.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday 10:30 to 6, Tuesday 10:30 to 5, Wednesday 11 to 6, Thursday and Friday 10:30 to 6, Saturday 10:30 to 5 and Sunday 12 to 4. Holiday hours can change, so call (812) 339-1818 if you are not sure.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome, but appointments are appreciated. Book online any time or call (812) 339-1818 to grab a time.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: Men's haircut $35, haircut + beard $45, women's cut $45 (shoulder length or shorter) or $55 (longer). Color and perms vary by hair, so ask your stylist. Full menu on the Services page.
- Q: Where are you, and where do I park?
  A: 1400 E 3rd St, Suite C, in Jordan Square, a short walk from the IU campus. Parking in front is free for Jordan Square customers, and there is bike parking.
- Q: Do you cut men's and kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts and trims are all part of the day here, and Sharma does men's cuts and fades.
- Q: Can you do vivid colors like pink or orange?
  A: Yes. Bright fashion color is a favorite, along with highlights and natural shades. Bring a photo of the look you want.
